description: A semaphore permit whose obligation the region's max_obligations refuses is untracked, and its release still returns the permit (regression of 819502b, found by fuzz seeds 1100-1238). r.main allows one obligation (set at 0; the tasks start acquiring at 10). t.b runs first and its permit obligation is admitted; t.a's, registered after it, is refused when t.a's poll returns (the obligation post drain), so t.a's permit is untracked. At 60 t.b releases and t.c, waiting since 20, is granted (its obligation admitted, t.b's having been committed). At 160 t.a releases its untracked permit with ASX_OK. C refused that release with ASX_E_STALE_HANDLE (the refused obligation's slot had been reused by t.c's) and kept the permit.
